name: backup
description: Backup Backup is a unified backup service designed to protect Amazon Web Services services and their associated data.

subcommands.name: associate-backup-vault-mpa-approval-team
subcommands.description: Associates an MPA approval team with a backup vault.

subcommands.name: cancel-legal-hold
subcommands.description: Removes the specified legal hold on a recovery point.

subcommands.name: create-backup-plan
subcommands.description: Creates a backup plan using a backup plan name and backup rules.

subcommands.name: create-backup-selection
subcommands.description: Creates a JSON document that specifies a set of resources to assign to a backup plan.

subcommands.name: create-backup-vault
subcommands.description: Creates a logical container where backups are stored.

subcommands.name: create-framework
subcommands.description: Creates a framework with one or more controls.

subcommands.name: create-legal-hold
subcommands.description: Creates a legal hold on a recovery point (backup).

subcommands.name: create-logically-air-gapped-backup-vault
subcommands.description: Creates a logical container to where backups may be copied.

subcommands.name: create-report-plan
subcommands.description: Creates a report plan.

subcommands.name: create-restore-access-backup-vault
subcommands.description: Creates a restore access backup vault that provides temporary access to recovery points in a logically air-gapped backup vault, subject to MPA approval.

subcommands.name: create-restore-testing-plan
subcommands.description: Creates a restore testing plan.

subcommands.name: create-restore-testing-selection
subcommands.description: This request can be sent after CreateRestoreTestingPlan request returns successfully.

subcommands.name: create-tiering-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates a tiering configuration.

subcommands.name: delete-backup-plan
subcommands.description: Deletes a backup plan.

subcommands.name: delete-backup-selection
subcommands.description: Deletes the resource selection associated with a backup plan that is specified by the SelectionId.

subcommands.name: delete-backup-vault
subcommands.description: Deletes the backup vault identified by its name.

subcommands.name: delete-backup-vault-access-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the policy document that manages permissions on a backup vault.

subcommands.name: delete-backup-vault-lock-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes Backup Vault Lock from a backup vault specified by a backup vault name.

subcommands.name: delete-backup-vault-notifications
subcommands.description: Deletes event notifications for the specified backup vault.

subcommands.name: delete-framework
subcommands.description: Deletes the framework specified by a framework name.

subcommands.name: delete-recovery-point
subcommands.description: Deletes the recovery point specified by a recovery point ID.

subcommands.name: delete-report-plan
subcommands.description: Deletes the report plan specified by a report plan name.

subcommands.name: delete-restore-testing-plan
subcommands.description: This request deletes the specified restore testing plan.

subcommands.name: delete-restore-testing-selection
subcommands.description: Input the Restore Testing Plan name and Restore Testing Selection name.

subcommands.name: delete-tiering-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes the tiering configuration specified by a tiering configuration name.

subcommands.name: describe-backup-job
subcommands.description: Returns backup job details for the specified BackupJobId.

subcommands.name: describe-backup-vault
subcommands.description: Returns metadata about a backup vault specified by its name.

subcommands.name: describe-copy-job
subcommands.description: Returns metadata associated with creating a copy of a resource.

subcommands.name: describe-framework
subcommands.description: Returns the framework details for the specified FrameworkName.

subcommands.name: describe-global-settings
subcommands.description: Describes whether the Amazon Web Services account has enabled different cross-account management options, including cross-account backup, multi-party approval, and delegated administrator.

subcommands.name: describe-protected-resource
subcommands.description: Returns information about a saved resource, including the last time it was backed up, its Amazon Resource Name (ARN), and the Amazon Web Services service type of the saved resource.

subcommands.name: describe-recovery-point
subcommands.description: Returns metadata associated with a recovery point, including ID, status, encryption, and lifecycle.

subcommands.name: describe-region-settings
subcommands.description: Returns the current service opt-in settings for the Region.

subcommands.name: describe-report-job
subcommands.description: Returns the details associated with creating a report as specified by its ReportJobId.

subcommands.name: describe-report-plan
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all report plans for an Amazon Web Services account and Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: describe-restore-job
subcommands.description: Returns metadata associated with a restore job that is specified by a job ID.

subcommands.name: describe-scan-job
subcommands.description: Returns scan job details for the specified ScanJobID.

subcommands.name: disassociate-backup-vault-mpa-approval-team
subcommands.description: Removes the association between an MPA approval team and a backup vault, disabling the MPA approval workflow for restore operations.

subcommands.name: disassociate-recovery-point
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified continuous backup recovery point from Backup and releases control of that continuous backup to the source service, such as Amazon RDS.

subcommands.name: disassociate-recovery-point-from-parent
subcommands.description: This action to a specific child (nested) recovery point removes the relationship between the specified recovery point and its parent (composite) recovery point.

subcommands.name: export-backup-plan-template
subcommands.description: Returns the backup plan that is specified by the plan ID as a backup template.

subcommands.name: get-backup-plan
subcommands.description: Returns BackupPlan details for the specified BackupPlanId.

subcommands.name: get-backup-plan-from-json
subcommands.description: Returns a valid JSON document specifying a backup plan or an error.

subcommands.name: get-backup-plan-from-template
subcommands.description: Returns the template specified by its templateId as a backup plan.

subcommands.name: get-backup-selection
subcommands.description: Returns selection metadata and a document in JSON format that specifies a list of resources that are associated with a backup plan.

subcommands.name: get-backup-vault-access-policy
subcommands.description: Returns the access policy document that is associated with the named backup vault.

subcommands.name: get-backup-vault-notifications
subcommands.description: Returns event notifications for the specified backup vault.

subcommands.name: get-legal-hold
subcommands.description: This action returns details for a specified legal hold.

subcommands.name: get-pitr-malware-scan-results
subcommands.description: Returns the malware scan results for a specified point in time within a continuous (point-in-time recovery) backup.

subcommands.name: get-recovery-point-index-details
subcommands.description: This operation returns the metadata and details specific to the backup index associated with the specified recovery point.

subcommands.name: get-recovery-point-restore-metadata
subcommands.description: Returns a set of metadata key-value pairs that were used to create the backup.

subcommands.name: get-restore-job-metadata
subcommands.description: This request returns the metadata for the specified restore job.

subcommands.name: get-restore-testing-inferred-metadata
subcommands.description: This request returns the minimal required set of metadata needed to start a restore job with secure default settings.

subcommands.name: get-restore-testing-plan
subcommands.description: Returns RestoreTestingPlan details for the specified RestoreTestingPlanName.

subcommands.name: get-restore-testing-selection
subcommands.description: Returns RestoreTestingSelection, which displays resources and elements of the restore testing plan.

subcommands.name: get-supported-resource-types
subcommands.description: Returns the Amazon Web Services resource types supported by Backup.

subcommands.name: get-tiering-configuration
subcommands.description: Returns TieringConfiguration details for the specified TieringConfigurationName.

subcommands.name: list-backup-job-summaries
subcommands.description: This is a request for a summary of backup jobs created or running within the most recent 30 days.

subcommands.name: list-backup-jobs
subcommands.description: Returns a list of existing backup jobs for an authenticated account for the last 30 days.

subcommands.name: list-backup-plan-templates
subcommands.description: Lists the backup plan templates.

subcommands.name: list-backup-plan-versions
subcommands.description: Returns version metadata of your backup plans, including Amazon Resource Names (ARNs), backup plan IDs, creation and deletion dates, plan names, and version IDs.

subcommands.name: list-backup-plans
subcommands.description: Lists the active backup plans for the account.

subcommands.name: list-backup-selections
subcommands.description: Returns an array containing metadata of the resources associated with the target backup plan.

subcommands.name: list-backup-vaults
subcommands.description: Returns a list of recovery point storage containers along with information about them.

subcommands.name: list-copy-job-summaries
subcommands.description: This request obtains a list of copy jobs created or running within the the most recent 30 days.

subcommands.name: list-copy-jobs
subcommands.description: Returns metadata about your copy jobs.

subcommands.name: list-frameworks
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all frameworks for an Amazon Web Services account and Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: list-indexed-recovery-points
subcommands.description: This operation returns a list of recovery points that have an associated index, belonging to the specified account.

subcommands.name: list-legal-holds
subcommands.description: This action returns metadata about active and previous legal holds.

subcommands.name: list-protected-resources
subcommands.description: Returns an array of resources successfully backed up by Backup, including the time the resource was saved, an Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the resource, and a resource type.

subcommands.name: list-protected-resources-by-backup-vault
subcommands.description: This request lists the protected resources corresponding to each backup vault.

subcommands.name: list-recovery-points-by-backup-vault
subcommands.description: Returns detailed information about the recovery points stored in a backup vault.

subcommands.name: list-recovery-points-by-legal-hold
subcommands.description: This action returns recovery point ARNs (Amazon Resource Names) of the specified legal hold.

subcommands.name: list-recovery-points-by-resource
subcommands.description: The information about the recovery points of the type specified by a resource Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

subcommands.name: list-report-jobs
subcommands.description: Returns details about your report jobs.

subcommands.name: list-report-plans
subcommands.description: Returns a list of your report plans.

subcommands.name: list-restore-access-backup-vaults
subcommands.description: Returns a list of restore access backup vaults associated with a specified backup vault.

subcommands.name: list-restore-job-summaries
subcommands.description: This request obtains a summary of restore jobs created or running within the the most recent 30 days.

subcommands.name: list-restore-jobs
subcommands.description: Returns a list of jobs that Backup initiated to restore a saved resource, including details about the recovery process.

subcommands.name: list-restore-jobs-by-protected-resource
subcommands.description: This returns restore jobs that contain the specified protected resource.

subcommands.name: list-restore-testing-plans
subcommands.description: Returns a list of restore testing plans.

subcommands.name: list-restore-testing-selections
subcommands.description: Returns a list of restore testing selections.

subcommands.name: list-scan-job-summaries
subcommands.description: This is a request for a summary of scan jobs created or running within the most recent 30 days.

subcommands.name: list-scan-jobs
subcommands.description: Returns a list of existing scan jobs for an authenticated account for the last 30 days.

subcommands.name: list-tags
subcommands.description: Returns the tags assigned to the resource, such as a target recovery point, backup plan, or backup vault.

subcommands.name: list-tiering-configurations
subcommands.description: Returns a list of tiering configurations.

subcommands.name: put-backup-vault-access-policy
subcommands.description: Sets a resource-based policy that is used to manage access permissions on the target backup vault.

subcommands.name: put-backup-vault-lock-configuration
subcommands.description: Applies Backup Vault Lock to a backup vault, preventing attempts to delete any recovery point stored in or created in a backup vault.

subcommands.name: put-backup-vault-notifications
subcommands.description: Turns on notifications on a backup vault for the specified topic and events.

subcommands.name: put-restore-validation-result
subcommands.description: This request allows you to send your independent self-run restore test validation results.

subcommands.name: revoke-restore-access-backup-vault
subcommands.description: Revokes access to a restore access backup vault, removing the ability to restore from its recovery points and permanently deleting the vault.

subcommands.name: start-backup-job
subcommands.description: Starts an on-demand backup job for the specified resource.

subcommands.name: start-copy-job
subcommands.description: Starts a job to create a one-time copy of the specified resource.

subcommands.name: start-report-job
subcommands.description: Starts an on-demand report job for the specified report plan.

subcommands.name: start-restore-job
subcommands.description: Recovers the saved resource identified by an Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

subcommands.name: start-scan-job
subcommands.description: Starts scanning jobs for specific resources.

subcommands.name: stop-backup-job
subcommands.description: Attempts to cancel a job to create a one-time backup of a resource.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Assigns a set of key-value pairs to a resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes a set of key-value pairs from a recovery point, backup plan, or backup vault identified by an Amazon Resource Name (ARN) This API is not supported for recovery points for resource types including Aurora, Amazon DocumentDB.

subcommands.name: update-backup-plan
subcommands.description: Updates the specified backup plan.

subcommands.name: update-framework
subcommands.description: Updates the specified framework.

subcommands.name: update-global-settings
subcommands.description: Updates whether the Amazon Web Services account has enabled different cross-account management options, including cross-account backup, multi-party approval, and delegated administrator.

subcommands.name: update-recovery-point-index-settings
subcommands.description: This operation updates the settings of a recovery point index.

subcommands.name: update-recovery-point-lifecycle
subcommands.description: Sets the transition lifecycle of a recovery point.

subcommands.name: update-region-settings
subcommands.description: Updates the current service opt-in settings for the Region.

subcommands.name: update-report-plan
subcommands.description: Updates the specified report plan.

subcommands.name: update-restore-testing-plan
subcommands.description: This request will send changes to your specified restore testing plan.

subcommands.name: update-restore-testing-selection
subcommands.description: Updates the specified restore testing selection.

subcommands.name: update-tiering-configuration
subcommands.description: This request will send changes to your specified tiering configuration.
